modules.production_responsibility: DLL deduplication — reads PE binary metadata (ECMA-335) to extract assembly identity; deduplicates by simple name

fragile_areas: PE binary format parsing — any .NET runtime or Aspose package change that alters PE metadata structure could break deduplication
CODED_INDEX_DEFS table covers ECMA-335 §24.2.6 — highly specific to .NET PE format; any PE extension or compression change could break parsing
Only deduplicates by simple name — if two genuinely different assemblies share a simple name (e.g., different version same name), the dedup logic may exclude the correct version
Error handling for malformed PE files not visible in first 60 lines — unclear how it handles corrupted DLLs

critical_cross_module_findings.impact: HIGH — _last_promoted_by.json in latest/ shows which family last promoted; evidence from prior families may be stale.

critical_cross_module_findings.description: release_status.py last_pr_number is structurally stale — reflects only most recent publish run's PR
critical_cross_module_findings.resolution: Structural limitation: last_pr_number is set from the most recent publish run. There is no mechanism to accumulate PR counts across runs. release-status.json shows last_pr_number=1 even though 4 PRs merged per family.
critical_cross_module_findings.impact: MEDIUM — misleading metric; not a bug, but a design gap
